args.subject: Trail Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend the Cascade Falls Trail in the national park. It's perfect for weekend hikes, about 3 miles round trip, and offers beautiful waterfall views along the way.

Hope you get a chance to check it out!

Best regards

args.subject: A Personal Trainer Recommendation: Alex
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Alex, a wonderful personal trainer at the gym on Main Street. Alex is great at creating customized workout plans tailored to your goals and fitness level.

I think you'd really enjoy working with Alex. Let me know if you'd like any more details!

Best regards

args.subject: Recommendation: Sarah, Piano Teacher
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I'd like to recommend Sarah, a fantastic piano teacher who specializes in classical music. She has been teaching for over 15 years and comes highly recommended.

Best regards

args.subject: Recommendation: FitTrack Fitness App
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend FitTrack, a new fitness app that's really helpful for tracking workouts. It also has great meal planning features, which make it easy to stay on top of your nutrition alongside your training.

I think you'd find it useful, so it's worth checking out.

Best regards

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery Downtown
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown! Their sourdough bread is incredible, and they bake fresh every morning starting at 6 AM, so it's worth stopping by early to get the best selection.

Enjoy!
